x: The winner on this occasion-Les Cohen, followed by Footer, Jack Flower, Duffett, Penny, Allum, Rice, Pyer, with, needless to say, a Belgrave team win of convincing proportions.

Our next man was Wally Bayliss (9th) who had run a splendid race, then came Rice (a disappointment this - 16th) and Buckingham completed our scoring four who are to be congratulated on finishing 3rd in the team race - to St.
Our scorers were Penny (3rd), Duffett(4th), Mitchell (5th), Cook (7th), Footer (9th) and Rice (15th). South London Harriers (120) were second and Mitcham A.C.
The Captain that day was Bert Footer and the rest of the team were Allum, Carter, Flower, Ginty, Parker, Patience; Shaw, Ring, Rice, Shields and Taylor.
